notes.subject: moya
notes.rationale: נפש ke motho wa go hema — mafoko a Sepedi a šomišitšwego ke a go hema le bophelo, e sego moyeng ya kgethilwego

notes.subject: ירשיעו
notes.rationale: go laola sebele — ba rokeletša madi a mahlologedi ka kahlolo ya maaka, selo se se feletšego kgahlanong le toka

notes.subject: יגודו
notes.rationale: go tšwa go גדד — ba bopagantšhwa kgahlanong le; ba kopanela go bolaea; mantšu a dikgethi a fapana

translation: Ba kgobokanela mmogo kgahlanong le moya wa yo lokilego, gomme ba laola madi a mahlologedi sebe.
